run.procedureSummary: 1. Feed: add the cycle's ration to each chamber, with no capacity check. 2. Overflow: walk chambers 1 to 6 in order. Any chamber over capacity is cut to capacity and the excess goes into the next chamber before that chamber is checked, so it can cascade. Excess from chamber 6 goes to the loss tally. 3. State check on post-overflow mass: LARVAL with mass >= upper mark becomes PUPAL; PUPAL with mass <= lower mark becomes LARVAL; otherwise the state holds. There is one check per chamber per cycle and every change is logged. 4. Metabolism: work out every amount from the mass at the start of this step, using the state just set (LARVAL floor(m/4), PUPAL floor(m/2)), then apply them all at once. Each chamber loses its amount. LARVAL amounts go to loss. PUPAL amounts go to chamber i-1, and chamber 1's PUPAL amount goes to loss. No capacity check, so a chamber can end the step over capacity. 5. Moult: if the line total is strictly greater than 38, halve every chamber, rounding down, and add the removed mass to loss. At exactly 38 or below, nothing happens.

openPoints.point: Which state sets the metabolism rate: the one before or after this cycle's state check
openPoints.assumption: The state after step 3 of the same cycle, because steps run in order and finish on all six chambers before the next step starts.

openPoints.point: How the moult rounds down when it halves an odd mass
openPoints.assumption: floor(m/2) is kept in the chamber. The removed amount, m - floor(m/2), goes to the loss tally, so the odd unit is lost.
'Strictly more than 38' means a total of exactly 38 does not trigger it. This happened in cycle 5 (total 38), so the moult did not fire.

openPoints.point: Chambers over capacity at the end of the run
openPoints.assumption: Per the write-up, they stay over and are reported as they are. Chamber 2 ends at 10 (capacity 8) and chamber 4 ends at 7 (capacity 6). No final overflow is applied.

openPoints.point: Where metabolism's PUPAL reabsorption sends mass that arrives in a chamber after the amounts are computed
openPoints.assumption: Nowhere further. All amounts come from mass at the start of the step, so mass reabsorbed into a chamber does not change that chamber's own amount in the same cycle.

run.notes: I used a short Python script for the arithmetic: rear2.py in the session scratchpad. Two chambers end the run over capacity, which the write-up allows: chamber 2 at 10 (capacity 8) and chamber 4 at 7 (capacity 6). The cycle 5 moult did not fire because the line total was exactly 38. A rule check found nothing breaking the rules: no mass went negative, and no chamber changed state more than once in a cycle.
